# Agent registry — single source of truth for agent metadata.
#
# This file drives scripts/generate_agents.py, which reads each agent's
# prompt body from prompts/<id>.md and writes tool-specific agent files
# into .claude/agents/.
#
# To add a new agent: write prompts/<id>.md, add an entry here, run
# `python3 scripts/generate_agents.py`, commit everything.
#
# tools: which capabilities the agent gets. Kept minimal on purpose —
# these are analysis/reporting agents, not code-modifying agents.
#   read  -> read files
#   grep  -> search file contents
#   glob  -> find files by pattern
#   bash  -> run shell commands (git log/diff, log parsing, test running)
#   write -> write output files
#   edit  -> NEVER enabled here. No agent in this pipeline edits source code.

agents:
  - id: context-analyzer
    description: >-
      Analyzes a project codebase and produces context.md capturing architecture,
      tech stack, key modules, integration points, and conventions. Use once when
      onboarding this pipeline to a new project, and re-run after major structural
      changes.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]

  - id: changelog-analyzer
    description: >-
      Analyzes a changelog, git diff, or set of commits for a new release and
      extracts the recent changes into changes.md. Use whenever a new release
      or build is being prepared for testing.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]

  - id: requirements-analyzer
    description: >-
      Optional agent. Extracts requirement/acceptance-criteria items tagged with
      their CR/requirement ID from an SRS or CR document, cross-references them
      against changes.md, and flags mismatches against code-scan.md's discovered
      business rules if that stage has run. Seeds the Requirement Traceability
      Matrix (rtm.md/rtm.csv) for the run. Use when a requirements/CR document is
      available for this release; skips itself plainly if not.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, write]

  - id: code-scanner
    description: >-
      Reviews only the changed code recorded in a run's changes.md for logic
      bugs, weak error handling, security concerns, convention violations, and
      leftover debug code, and extracts business rules, validations, feature
      flags, and integration points into plain user-facing language for QA.
      Advisory only — findings feed test-planner's risk rating and
      requirements-analyzer's mismatch detection; does not block the pipeline.
      Use after changelog-analyzer.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]

  - id: test-planner
    description: >-
      Analyzes changes.md against context.md to identify impacted areas
      (direct and ripple/regression impact) and produces a thorough test-plan.md.
      Use after changelog-analyzer, before writing test cases.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]

  - id: test-case-writer
    description: >-
      Converts an approved test-plan.md into detailed manual test cases, each
      tagged with Origin (requirement- vs. implementation-based), Category
      (functional/regression/boundary/negative/security/accessibility), and
      Automation Candidate for fast review, and updates the run's RTM. Use
      after the test plan has been reviewed and approved by a human.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, write]

  - id: log-analyzer
    description: >-
      Analyzes application, server, or test execution logs to surface errors,
      anomalies, and patterns, producing log-analysis.md. Use during test
      execution or when investigating unexpected behavior.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]

  - id: rca-analyst
    description: >-
      Performs root cause analysis on a reported defect using code, logs, and
      recent changes as evidence, producing a structured RCA report. Use after
      a bug is found and before filing the formal bug report.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]

  - id: bug-reporter
    description: >-
      Writes a bug report strictly following the user-supplied template in
      templates/bug-report.template.md, using the RCA report and test case
      as source evidence, and updates the run's RTM with the new defect ID.
      Use after rca-analyst has completed its analysis.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, write]

  - id: release-notes-writer
    description: >-
      Prepares the test closure report and release notes at the end of a test
      cycle, summarizing scope, results, defects, risks, and changes delivered.
      Use once testing for a release is complete.
    tools: [read, grep, glob, bash, write]
